channel.title: The Grant Desk - added in last 30 days, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: added in last 30 days, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily. Each drop carries at most 10 grants, closest deadlines first; the rest follow the next Sunday.

item.title: wpZimmer: Open Call 2027 residencies for collectives (Antwerp)
item.description: wpZimmer · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · EUR 5,000 (excl. VAT) financial contribution per collective, managed by the collective, plus a five-week residency with two workspaces (a technically equipped studio of approx. 18m x 17m and a medium atelier of approx. 4m x 13m adapted to physical practices) and shared accommodation for up to 6 people. Four collectives selected. No application fee.

item.title: Stigler Center: Journalists in Residence Program Spring 2027 (Chicago Booth)
item.description: Stigler Center, University of Chicago Booth School of Business · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · USD 14,000 stipend to cover living expenses over the 12-week program, plus reimbursement of economy-class airfare to and from Chicago, SEVIS and visa application fees, health insurance through UChicago, and housing guidance. The stipend is subject to up to 14 percent tax withholding for international participants, and you need sufficient funds for roughly the first month before the stipend arrives. No application fee.

item.title: LASR Labs Winter 2027 (London AI Safety Research)
item.description: LASR Labs, hosted at the London Initiative for Safe AI (LISA) · deadline Closed 20 Sep 2026 · GBP 15,000 stipend for the 13-week programme, plus food, office space, and flights/travel. No application fee.

item.title: NARS Foundation: Curatorial Fellowship 2027 (NYC)
item.description: NARS Foundation · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 3,000 stipend for the six-month fellowship, plus sustained access to the NARS international and US artist residency community and staff support for the resulting exhibitions. No application fee listed for the curatorial track.

item.title: ILIAD Fellowship: Mentored AI Alignment Research (November and December 2026 cohorts)
item.description: ILIAD · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 6,000 per month travel-and-housing allowance for the 3-month fellowship. No tuition or application fee.

item.title: Netflix x NALIP Director Incubator 2026-27 (short film grants)
item.description: NALIP (National Association of Latino Independent Producers) with Netflix · deadline 21 Sep 2026 · USD 45,000 production grant for each of four selected directors to create an original narrative short film, plus individualized guidance, career development opportunities, and an industry showcase. No application fee, but current NALIP membership is required to apply.

item.title: Can Serrat: Visual Art Residency 2027 full grants (El Bruc, Catalonia)
item.description: Can Serrat International Art Residency · deadline 23 Sep 2026 · Two fully funded places: one full grant with a EUR 2,000 honorarium (subject to public funding) plus a private room for six consecutive weeks from 2 August 2027, and one full grant with shared accommodation for one month in October 2027; both include two weekly communal dinners and basic food supplies. A EUR 3,000 production grant and return grants are additionally available to 2027 residents in December 2027. No application fee stated. The same call also offers around 20 partial grants where residents pay EUR 1,130 per month (shared room), EUR 1,745 per month (private room) or EUR 305 per month (studio only).

item.title: KTH Royal Institute of Technology: PhD, Feminist AI Addressing Gender-Based Violence
item.description: KTH Royal Institute of Technology, School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (Department of Computing and Learning Systems) · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · Fully funded, full-time employed doctoral position with monthly salary according to KTH's collectively agreed doctoral student salary agreement, plus Swedish employee benefits. No application fee.

item.title: Tech Policy Press Fellowship Program 2027
item.description: Tech Policy Press · deadline 24 Sep 2026 · USD 10,000 stipend per fellow, paid quarterly. Also included: editorial guidance from the Tech Policy Press team, membership of an international cohort with regular feedback and exchange, and monthly sessions to strengthen the work. Fellows' work is published on the Tech Policy Press website and promoted through the newsletter, podcast and events. No application fee.

item.title: Khoj x Mozilla Foundation: Counterstructures Residency 2026 (Delhi)
item.description: Khoj International Artists' Association in collaboration with Mozilla Foundation · deadline Closed 13 Sep 2026 · Mozilla's Creative Futures: Counterstructures programme publishes USD 2,500 per resident (USD 2,000 stipend plus a USD 500 materials budget), along with weekly in-person work sessions, guest lectures from practitioners across art, technology and community design, and publication of the finished project in the collective documentation report. CAVEAT: neither the Khoj call page nor the Mozilla application form restates a figure for this six-week Delhi edition, and the published package covers the ten-week format, so confirm the amount with Khoj before applying. No application fee.

item.title: 10 new grants - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• True Blue Fellowship 2027
    https://bowseat.org/programs/true-blue-fellowship/
    Bow Seat Ocean Awareness Programs · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Up to USD 2,500 in project funding per fellow, plus mentorship and capacity-building programming. Twelve youth are selected annually. No application fee.
  • Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
    Archipel Butor · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
  • Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Travel Fellowship 2026
    https://www.lasellefoundation.org/travel-fellowship
    Dorothy Antoinette LaSelle Foundation · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Two awards of USD 5,000 each, distributed in the fall of 2026, to fund a research trip that furthers the artist's practice. No application fee.
  • Tartu UNESCO City of Literature Residency for Writers and Translators, Autumn 2026
    https://tartu.kirjandus.ee/residency-autumn-2026
    Estonian Literary Society (Eesti Kirjanduse Selts), Focal Point for Tartu UNESCO City of Literature · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Monthly stipend of EUR 600 for the two-month stay (EUR 1,200 in total), plus reimbursement of travel costs up to EUR 350. Free accommodation is provided in the Karl Ristikivi residency apartment, which has a bedroom, living room, kitchen, bathroom and exhibition room. One resident is selected. No application fee.
  • Le Garage Moderne: OASIS International Artist Residencies 2026 (Bordeaux)
    https://legaragemoderne.org/oasis2026
    Le Garage Moderne (European OASIS project) · deadline Closed 01 Sep 2026 · Five grants. Each artist receives a fee of EUR 1,300 gross (taxes may apply depending on legal status), up to EUR 600 for production expenses such as raw materials, technical services or special tools, a lump-sum travel grant scaled to distance with top-ups for green travel options, a per diem of EUR 45 per day, and accommodation in a self-catering hotel. Access to the shared tools and spaces of Le Garage Moderne is included, subject to the association's regulations. No application fee.
  • Epic MegaGrants 2026 (Cycle 2)
    https://www.unrealengine.com/megagrants
    Epic Games · deadline Closed 04 Sep 2026 · Typical grants range from USD 5,000 to USD 75,000, with some exceptional projects receiving up to USD 150,000. Epic states that recipients continue to own their IP and may publish it however they wish, so this is a grant rather than an investment or equity deal. Grants up to and including USD 25,000 may be paid in a single instalment; larger grants are paid across several instalments tied to continued progress. Funds are for project and team expenses such as development and hiring; hardware purchases or rentals are approved only occasionally, case by case. No application fee.
  • Numeric 2026: The Word (Les antipodes Research and Creation Residency)
    https://lesantipodes.com/numeric/2026_bases_en.html
    Les antipodes, with Bolit Centre d'Art Contemporani Girona and Museu de l'Emporda Figueres · deadline Closed 08 Sep 2026 · Two grants. Each provides a stipend of EUR 1,000 as taxable base (taxes and withholdings apply), round-trip travel within the European Union, and accommodation and meals for the four weeks in Agullana. Travel and meals cover the resident only, though the shared apartment can host immediate family by arrangement. Numeric also provides the resources specified in the application and agreed during preparation. No application fee. Note that if a selected candidate lacks the professional registration needed to receive the stipend and payment has to be arranged through Les antipodes, the resulting costs are deducted from the stipend.
  • New_ Public Entrepreneur in Residence, Pilot Cohort
    https://newpublic.org/EIR
    New_ Public · deadline Closed 09 Sep 2026 · Stipend of USD 22,500, paid in three monthly installments across the residency, each contingent on continued active participation. Plus USD 1,500 toward an AI tool of the resident's choice for coding, prototyping or design. Two residents are selected in the pilot cohort. Also provided: hands-on product and strategy support from senior New_ Public staff and outside experts; access to New_ Public's five years of original research on moderation, governance, community stewardship and platform design, plus direct access to the researchers behind it; and introductions across New_ Public's network of major platforms, startups, university researchers and funders for hiring, fundraising, early user testing and community partnerships. Residents must submit a Form W-9 or W-8BEN to receive the stipend. No application fee.
  • BOLD Fellow, British Open-ended Learning and Discovery Lab
    https://eng.ox.ac.uk/jobs/job-detail?vacancyID=187853
    University of Oxford, Department of Engineering Science (BOLD Lab, with UCL and Imperial College London) · deadline Closed 15 Sep 2026 · Salary on Oxford Grade 10R, GBP 65,336 to GBP 84,663 per year, with the posting noting that further salary options are being explored. Benefits include associate membership at Reuben College, 38 days annual leave, pension scheme, childcare services, and travel expenses for stakeholder and conference visits. Fellows also get access to substantial compute: 3 million GPU hours on Isambard for the first 18 months, with the lab working towards 5,000 H100-equivalents in total across industry and government support. No application fee.
  • This is Gender Regional Curatorial Fellowship 2026
    https://thisisgender.global5050.org/regional-curatorial-fellowship/
    This is Gender (Global 50/50) · deadline 22 Sep 2026 · Stipend of up to GBP 3,000 for the seven-month part-time fellowship. No application fee.
